tools.name: forgepilot_status
tools.description: Read current ForgePilot repository status. This tool is read-only.

tools.name: forgepilot_get_opencode_status
tools.description: Read constrained OpenCode executor readiness. This tool is read-only and does not start OpenCode.

tools.name: forgepilot_get_opencode_capabilities
tools.description: Read ForgePilot/OpenCode capability state. This tool is read-only, uses static policy discovery, and does not start OpenCode.

tools.name: forgepilot_get_remote_runner_status
tools.description: Read remote runner capability status. This tool may contact only the configured runner capabilities endpoint and never starts OpenCode.

tools.name: forgepilot_list_packets
tools.description: List ForgePilot packet files. This tool is read-only.

tools.name: forgepilot_list_runs
tools.description: List ForgePilot run directories. This tool is read-only.

tools.name: forgepilot_validate_opencode_run_request
tools.description: Validate a ForgePilot-scoped OpenCode run request without starting OpenCode or creating artifacts.

tools.name: forgepilot_create_opencode_run_request
tools.description: Create a durable ForgePilot OpenCode run request artifact without starting OpenCode.

tools.name: forgepilot_list_opencode_run_requests
tools.description: List existing OpenCode request artifact files for a ForgePilot packet. This tool is read-only and does not start OpenCode.

tools.name: forgepilot_read_opencode_run_request
tools.description: Read one existing OpenCode request artifact by packet id and request id. This tool is read-only and does not start OpenCode.

tools.name: forgepilot_validate_remote_runner_request
tools.description: Validate whether an existing OpenCode request artifact is eligible for future remote runner handoff. This tool is read-only and does not contact the runner.

tools.name: forgepilot_validate_remote_runner_endpoint_request
tools.description: Validate an existing OpenCode request artifact with the configured remote runner validate-request endpoint. This tool does not start OpenCode.

tools.name: forgepilot_validate_execution_preflight
tools.description: Validate guarded execution preflight gates without starting OpenCode or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_record_execution_artifact_dry_run
tools.description: Record FP-MCP-035 contract-shaped dry-run artifacts without starting OpenCode or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_verify_execution_artifact_dry_run
tools.description: Verify FP-MCP-036 dry-run artifacts without writing files, starting OpenCode, or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_get_execution_enablement_status
tools.description: Evaluate execution enablement policy gates without enabling execution, starting OpenCode, or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_get_execution_disable_switch_status
tools.description: Read execution disable switch status without enabling execution, starting OpenCode, mutating approvals, or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_record_real_human_approval_evidence
tools.description: Record real human approval evidence as a scoped create-only observation without enabling execution, consuming approval, starting OpenCode, or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_record_human_approval_consumption
tools.description: Record append-only human approval consumption evidence without mutating approval artifacts, enabling execution, starting OpenCode, or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_record_human_approval_evidence_dry_run_fixture
tools.description: Record a non-authorizing human approval evidence dry-run fixture without creating real approval, enabling execution, starting OpenCode, or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_validate_human_approval_record
tools.description: Validate a human approval evidence artifact without creating approval, enabling execution, starting OpenCode, or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_record_pre_start_evidence_dry_run
tools.description: Record a non-executing pre-start evidence dry-run artifact without starting OpenCode or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_validate_pre_start_evidence
tools.description: Validate pre-start evidence for a ForgePilot request without creating evidence, starting OpenCode, or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_validate_start_request_state_snapshot
tools.description: Validate start request pre/post state snapshots without creating snapshots, starting OpenCode, or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_record_start_state_snapshot_dry_run
tools.description: Record non-executing pre/post start state snapshot dry-run artifacts without starting OpenCode or contacting the runner start endpoint.

tools.name: forgepilot_get_guarded_start_preflight_report
tools.description: Read a non-executing guarded start preflight report without contacting the runner start endpoint, starting OpenCode, consuming approval, or mutating request artifacts.

tools.name: forgepilot_start_remote_runner_request
tools.description: Request the configured private dev runner to start an OpenCode run only after approval, artifact, disable-switch, and pre-start evidence gates pass.

tools.name: forgepilot_read_file
tools.description: Read a text file from allowed ForgePilot repository paths only: packets/, runs/, docs/, or metrics/. This tool is read-only.

tools.name: forgepilot_execute_terminal_command
tools.description: Execute one human-approved terminal command inside an allowlisted workspace. The MCP tool invocation itself is the approval request. Hard-blocked commands (sudo, .env reads, rm -rf /, curl|sh, etc.) are refused even after UI approval. Unknown workspaces fail closed.

tools.name: forgepilot_persist_opencode_worker_telemetry
tools.description: Persist an existing OpenCode worker telemetry.json artifact into ForgePilot SQLite without admitting it as evidence.

tools.name: forgepilot_query_persisted_opencode_worker_telemetry
tools.description: Query persisted OpenCode worker telemetry observations from ForgePilot SQLite without mutating telemetry, admitting evidence, or touching live workers.

tools.name: forgepilot_read_persisted_opencode_worker_telemetry
tools.description: Read persisted OpenCode worker telemetry from ForgePilot SQLite without mutating the database.

tools.name: forgepilot_capture_opencode_worker_telemetry
tools.description: Capture normalized, non-admitted telemetry for an existing OpenCode worker and write telemetry.json under the worker directory.

tools.name: forgepilot_read_opencode_worker_telemetry
tools.description: Read an existing OpenCode worker telemetry.json artifact without recapturing or mutating telemetry.

tools.name: forgepilot_start_opencode_worker
tools.description: Start a fresh bounded OpenCode worker run and record worker lifecycle evidence under runs/<packetId>/opencode-workers/<workerId>/.

tools.name: forgepilot_get_opencode_worker_status
tools.description: Read and refresh status for an existing OpenCode worker without starting, stopping, or restarting any process.

tools.name: forgepilot_read_opencode_worker_result
tools.description: Read bounded stdout/stderr and status for an existing OpenCode worker without starting, stopping, or restarting any process.

tools.name: forgepilot_capture_workspace_snapshot
tools.description: Capture a read-only ForgePilot workspace state snapshot and write an append-only snapshot artifact under runs/<packetId-or-OPERATOR>/workspace-snapshots/.
